retrievalProfile.description: A multi-portrait grid layout featuring a central graphic anchor and high-contrast typography for ensemble cast branding.

recipe.visualDefinition: A 4x3 or 3x4 grid of individual headshots surrounding a central dark void that contains a prominent oval logo and stacked typographic information. The portraits are closely cropped, featuring diverse lighting but consistent dark backgrounds to unify the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Peripheral portraits framing a central graphic core
High-contrast white and light blue text against a black central field
Consistent eye-level perspective across all portrait subjects
Symmetrical balance between the left and right columns of images
coreInvariants: A central oval graphic containing script-style lettering
A grid-based arrangement of individual portraits
A dark, neutral background for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Twelve individual portraits of equal scale arranged in a perimeter grid; central 2x2 area reserved for branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large blue-outlined oval containing neon-style script text located in the upper-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular path starting from the top-left portrait, moving around the perimeter, and settling on the central text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the black central rectangle and thin gutters between portraits.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric Blue (logo outline and script glow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark backgrounds; moderate saturation in portraits.

letterConstructionRules: Script text features a continuous baseline with a glowing neon effect
Block text uses heavy, uniform stroke weights with flat terminals
Horizontal bars are used to separate different levels of information
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the block text has a wide, open aperture
The script 'I' is stylized with a distinctive loop

composition.position: top center of the dark void

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a fluid, glowing script and a rigid, heavy geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight of the secondary display text
Approximates the casual, connected feel of the logo script

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 4x3 grid of 12 diverse headshots with dark backgrounds, leaving the central 2x2 area as a solid black rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a blue-glowing oval in the top half of the black rectangle with script text inside. Below it, add two lines of heavy white sans-serif text separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the central void perfectly centered?
Does the script text have a blue outer glow?
Are the portraits uniform in scale?
Is the block text in all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the grid
mustRedesign: Ensure all portrait subjects are unique and AI-generated
Change the specific wording to generic placeholders
postGenerationChecks: Verify central alignment of the oval
Ensure no text is cut off by the grid
Confirm the neon effect is visible against the black
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid of portraits + central dark void + oval script logo + stacked sans-serif metadata.
